Kenny did 324 jumping jacks last week.  
This week so far:  
Sunday: 34  
Monday: 20  
Tuesday: 0 (skipped)  
Wednesday: 123  
Thursday: 64  
Friday: 23  

Sum so far = 34 + 20 + 0 + 123 + 64 + 23  
= 34 + 20 = 54  
54 + 123 = 177  
177 + 64 = 241  
241 + 23 = 264  

To beat last week’s 324, he needs at least 325 total.  
So Saturday’s needed = 325 – 264 = 61.  

Final answer: 61
